scripts.predev: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @bsp/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/admin" "npm run dev -w apps/status"
scripts.build: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared && npm run build -w @bsp/admin && npm run build -w @bsp/api && npm run build -w @bsp/status && npm run build -w @better-forge/template
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && npm run typecheck:apps
scripts.typecheck:apps: tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin && tsc --noEmit -p apps/status && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/template && tsc --noEmit -p apps/template/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:api: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared && tsx --test apps/api/test/*.test.ts apps/template/test/*.test.ts packages/*/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:api:coverage: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared && node --import tsx --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="apps/api/src/**" --test-coverage-include="packages/{contracts,db,audit,auth,vault,notify,backup,config-as-code,mcp,runtime,ui}/dist/**" --test-coverage-exclude="**/*.d.ts" --test-coverage-lines=94 --test-coverage-branches=78 --test-coverage-functions=91 apps/api/test/*.test.ts apps/template/test/*.test.ts packages/*/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:frontend: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared && vitest run
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared && vitest run --coverage
scripts.bench: npm run build:kit && npm run build -w @bsp/shared && tsx apps/api/bench/scale.ts
scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
